description: This file defines an internal generic class StreamConsumer<T> implementing IInternalAsyncObservable<T> for managing stream subscriptions, including subscribing, resuming, unsubscribing, and cleanup logic within the Orleans streaming framework.

classes.name: StreamConsumer<T>
classes.description: An internal class for consuming streams, handling subscription lifecycle and coordination with pub/sub system.

methods.name: SubscribeAsync
methods.description: Subscribes an observer or batch observer to the stream.

methods.name: ResumeAsync
methods.description: Resumes a subscription with a previous handle.

methods.name: UnsubscribeAsync
methods.description: Unsubscribes from the stream using the specified handle.

methods.name: GetAllSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all active subscriptions for the stream.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up all subscriptions and observers.

methods.name: InternalRemoveObserver
methods.description: Removes an observer for testing purposes.

methods.name: DiagGetConsumerObserversCount
methods.description: Returns the count of stream observers for diagnostics.
